# T001: Health page that polls /healthz

## Goal
When this task is done, `/health` serves a static page that calls `/healthz` every ten seconds and shows a green or red dot.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the app is up, When `/health` is opened, Then the page shows "OK" within ten seconds.
- Given `/healthz` answers 503, When the page polls, Then it shows "Down".

## Target files
- src/pages/health.html
- src/server.ts
- test/health.test.ts

## Contracts
None.

## Out of scope
- Anything beyond the one page.

## Notes for the worker
Written against a later brief format; this orch does not read it.
